item.description: During the early years of the Battle of the Atlantic, Allied merchant ships faced constant threat from long-range German bombers. item.description: On February 6, 1945, U.S. Army Air Forces heavy bombers began a sustained aerial offensive on the island of Iwo Jima in the Pacific. item.title: On This Day in WWII (1941): MacKay Trophy Winner Capt. Richard Freeman Killed in B-17B Crash
item.description: On February 6, 1941, Captain Richard S. Freeman of the United States Army Air Corps was killed when a B-17B Flying Fortress crashed near Lovelock, Nevada.
